findings.title: Direct LLM API calls in emergency alert bypass model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral using raw environment API keys instead of routing via the centralized model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to request completions through the model router service

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures uniform telemetry, centralized model governance, policy fallback, and prevents API token leakage

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router audit indicates call_log_exists is false at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory exists and the model router service initializes and rotates call_log.jsonl

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call volume, failure rates, and token consumption

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 hooks and quality query placeholders in runtime commands

evidence.observation: Multiple TODO comments for Phase 5 implementation including Supabase authorization and decision_to_memory integration
recent_anomalies assigned to empty list with TODO to query quality_anomalies table

proposed_action.description: Implement the quality_anomalies query and wire up Phase 5 authorization and memory integration

findings.expected_benefit: Replaces stubbed data and incomplete feature stubs with operational database-backed logic

findings.title: Recent call failures detected in model router service

evidence.observation: router_status reports 2 recent failed requests despite router and ollama being reachable

proposed_action.description: Examine model router error handling and Ollama response timeouts to determine root cause of recent failures

findings.expected_benefit: Increases LLM routing success rate and prevents unhandled inference failures in dependent agents
